rule: Every source declared in OUTSTANDING_SOURCES.json is read and totalled here. A source whose pattern stops matching reports zero, which is the most dangerous number this estate can print, so the generator exits 2 rather than reporting it.
whatThisDoesNotTellYou: It counts items, and items are not equal. One agency decision can gate more than ten provisioning steps, and the flow-truth review's twenty-nine findings are against a single package. Read docs/deployment/PLAN.md for what to do next, in the order that unblocks the most; this exists to stop work hiding, not to prioritise it. It also cannot tell you that a finding in a record has been overtaken: audits are never edited to agree with the present, so their findings stay counted until a tracked source supersedes them — the honest default, and occasionally an overcount.
